title: Extract all part types from Antigravity payloads and summaries DB
description: Minimal protobuf decoding of user-turn payloads plus the summaries SQLite; map to normalized parts with file/row provenance. Done when: fixture extraction yields the expected parts.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Extraction maps transcript steps into chapter-1 Messages ordered by explicit step_index (shuffled file order normalized): USER_INPUT -> User, PLANNER_RESPONSE -> Assistant, CHECKPOINT -> compaction summary, ERROR_MESSAGE -> error System message, created_at -> timestamps. The payload DB (read through a snapshot copy) supplies tool-call linkage the transcript lacks via its tool_links table keyed by step_index: TOOL_CALL records get the DB call id and a linked ToolResult message. Hot WAL DBs digest-verified never mutated; live app keeps writing. Malformed steps and unknown types skipped with counters. Full gate green.

right_now_summary: The team is extracting payload parts and summary rows into a normalized format with source details.
